description: Checks whether a company or agency is named in the MORVS Drone Register, which compiles US government drone approval, restriction and compliance records: the DCMA Blue UAS Cleared List and Framework, FCC UAS Conditional Approvals, FAA Remote ID Declarations of Compliance, and the drone-linked entries of the Section 1260H list, the BIS Entity List and OFAC's NS-CMIC list. Matches by name or alias (case, punctuation and legal-suffix insensitive; substrings allowed) and returns each match's designations with the government record that names it, attached reference records, and federal contract totals where loaded. A non-match is reported as not found in the register; it is not clearance or a compliance determination.

limit.description: Maximum matching entities to return; default 10, max 50.

name.description: Company or agency name or alias, e.g. DJI, Skydio or Autel Robotics; ignores case, punctuation and legal suffixes, substrings allowed.

name: drone_company_check
title: Check Drone Register Company
